messages:
noah (Growth): Idea: quick-start local refapp + tiny reproducible benchmark + one-pager launch. aim: developers and community leads. low-friction.
rhea (DevRel): 👍 keep repo minimal: Dockerfile + start.sh + run-bench.sh. record p50/p95 and tokens for 2 profiles.
harper (Content): i'll draft a short blog (600-800 words) and a GH README that doubles as a tutorial. need headline options.
zane (Design): i'll do an OG image + 6s screencap GIF of the local run. prefer neutral styling so folks can fork easily.
noah (Growth): timeline idea: draft by 05/04, design by 05/08, GH + blog by 05/11, announce week of 05/13, micro-webinar 05/18.
rhea (DevRel): add UTMs: `?utm_source=localref&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch`. include sample curl with UTM.
harper (Content): messaging A/B subjects: A) "Run LLMs locally in 10 minutes" B) "Build and benchmark a local LLM refapp". we'll test small seed.
zane (Design): will upload two hero variants for the A/B by 05/07. also provide smaller inline screenshots for the README.
noah (Growth): inbound routing: CTA -> registration form -> GTM -> webhook to #sales-inbound. ops: can we get a GTM container + webhook guide?
ops-bot: INC-6120 created: GTM container + slack webhook doc, ETA 8h.
rhea (DevRel): infra: need a short 24h GPU slot to produce canonical numbers (1xA100). ops-bot?
ops-bot: INC-6121 created: 1xA100 for 24h reserved, ETA 10h.
harper (Content): i'll post the first draft here by EOD 05/04 for quick edits. keep feedback terse.
noah (Growth): owners: content=harper, devrel=rhea, design=zane, growth=noah. small launch sync 05/06. :rocket:
